end.summary:
Explored how a ghee tin can roll, slide, and stack.
Identified the curved side as the rolling surface.
Connected flat surfaces with sliding and stacking.
Initially questioned stacking, then corrected this using the example of tins placed one above another.
end.parentNote: Anika practised describing how a cylindrical tin can roll on its curved side, slide on a flat base, and stack on flat tops. They used observation and a real-life example of ghee tins being placed one above another; the stacking mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, ask them to find one household object and describe which parts help it roll, slide, or stack.
